name: whoisockyo
description: A full-stack developer portfolio with a private content dashboard.

scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/shared build && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/web dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/api dev"
scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/web dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/api dev
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/web build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @whoisockyo/web typecheck
